q1.question: What is the learning format at Yaser USMLE?
q1.answer: We offer structured, systems-based recorded courses combined with practice quizzes, flashcards, and a study planner — all in one platform designed specifically for USMLE Step 1 preparation.

q2.question: Who are the courses designed for?
q2.answer: For medical students and graduates preparing for USMLE Step 1 who want a structured, evidence-based approach guided by expert educators.

q3.question: How do I access a course after enrolling?
q3.answer: After your enrollment is approved, you will have immediate access to all course lectures, materials, quizzes, and flashcards from your student dashboard.

q4.question: What payment methods are supported?
q4.answer: We support manual bank transfer payments. Upload your payment proof and our team will verify and activate your access within one business day.

q5.question: Is content available in Arabic and English?
q5.answer: The platform interface supports Arabic and English. Each course page identifies the teaching language and available materials before enrollment.

q6.question: What should I do if I have an account or access issue?
q6.answer: Contact our support team from the contact page or open a ticket from your student dashboard, and we will review any account, payment, or access issue.

publicRefund.title: Refund Policy
publicRefund.subtitle: This policy explains which cases can be reviewed, what we need to process a request, how decisions are made, and how approved amounts are returned.
publicRefund.caseReview: Each case is reviewed on its facts
publicRefund.beforeRequestBody: Prepare your account email, order number, payment proof, and reason for requesting a refund.

scope.title: Scope of this policy
scope.body: This policy applies to course and bundle purchases paid directly to Yaser USMLE. Eligibility depends on activation status, content usage, the reason for the request, and any terms clearly displayed on the offer page at purchase.

eligible.title: Cases that may be eligible
eligible.body: Requests are reviewed fairly, and the examples below do not mean automatic approval. The team verifies payment and access records before deciding.

points.1: A duplicate charge or transfer for the same transaction.
points.2: A material failure by the platform to provide paid content.
points.3: A request made before activation or substantial content use.

notEligible.title: Cases generally not eligible
notEligible.body: Because content is digital, a request may be declined when the service has been substantially used or the terms of use have been violated.

points.1: Completing or viewing a substantial portion of a course or downloading resources.
points.2: Access expiration or a change of mind after using the content.
points.3: Account suspension for sharing access, copying content, or misuse.

request.title: How to submit a request
request.body: Submit promptly through the official contact page using the email linked to your account. A complete request helps the team reach a decision sooner.

points.1: Include the order number and course or bundle name.
points.2: Attach payment proof and specify the transfer method and date.
points.3: Clearly explain your reason and any technical issue encountered.

review.title: Review and decision
review.body: The team reviews payment status, activation time, access history, and relevant communication. We may ask for more information to verify identity or the transaction. The decision is sent through your registered contact method and may be full or partial where appropriate.

processing.title: Returning an approved amount
processing.body: Once approved, funds are returned to the original payment method where possible or through a verified transfer method agreed by both parties. Posting time depends on the bank or payment provider and generally excludes non-refundable external fees.

contact.title: Questions and reconsideration
contact.body: If you believe a decision missed important information, reply with supporting documents and ask for reconsideration. Contact us before opening a bank dispute so the team can review the transaction, without limiting rights available under applicable law.

publicRefund.footerTitle: Would you like us to review a purchase?
publicRefund.footerBody: Send the order details and payment proof from the email connected to your account, and our support team will review them.

publicPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
publicPrivacy.subtitle: This policy explains what data we collect, why we use it, how we protect it, and the choices available when you use the Yaser USMLE learning experience.
publicPrivacy.promiseBody: We use data to operate your learning experience and support your account. We do not sell your personal data to advertisers.
publicPrivacy.requestBody: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data, subject to applicable law.

noSale.title: We do not sell your data
noSale.body: Learners' personal information is not sold for advertising.

transparent.title: Transparent use
transparent.body: We collect what is needed to operate accounts, learning, and support.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: You can review and update information and submit privacy requests.

collection.title: Data we collect
collection.body: The data we process depends on how you use the platform and the features you choose. You provide some information directly, while other data is generated during learning.

points.2: Enrollments, progress, exams, and study plans.
points.3: Payment requests, transfer proof, and subscription history.
points.4: Device, usage, and support communication data.

usage.title: How we use data
usage.body: We use information to provide contracted services, maintain security, improve content and learner experience, and meet applicable legal requirements.

points.1: Create accounts and enroll you in courses and bundles.
points.2: Save progress and present results and learning recommendations.
points.3: Review payments and respond to support requests.
points.4: Prevent fraud, analyze performance, and improve the platform.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technology
cookies.body: The platform may use cookies and local storage needed to sign you in, remember language and settings, secure sessions, and measure performance. You can control non-essential cookies through browser settings where available, but disabling essential storage may affect the service.

sharing.title: When we share data
sharing.body: We do not sell personal information. We may share the minimum necessary with service providers acting on our behalf, when required by law, or to protect platform and user rights.

points.1: Hosting, infrastructure, and secure storage providers.
points.2: Email, notification, and customer support services.
points.3: Payment providers when an integrated payment method is used.
points.4: Competent authorities under a valid legal obligation.

security.title: Information security
security.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational controls to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, or loss. No transmission or storage method is completely secure, so use a strong password and report suspicious activity.

retention.title: How long we retain data
retention.body: We retain information while an account is active and as necessary to provide services, meet financial and legal obligations, and resolve disputes. When no longer needed, data is securely deleted or anonymized under applicable retention practices.

rights.title: Your rights and choices
rights.body: Subject to applicable law, you may submit a request concerning your data. We may need to verify your identity before acting, and limited legal exceptions may apply.

points.1: Access a copy of your personal data.
points.2: Correct inaccurate information or update it.
points.3: Request deletion or restriction of certain processing.
points.4: Opt out of marketing and adjust your preferences.

updates.title: Policy updates and contact
updates.body: We may update this policy when services or legal requirements change. The new version and date will be published here, with additional notice for material changes where appropriate. Use the official contact page for questions or requests.

publicPrivacy.footerBody: If you have a question about your data or want to exercise a right, send a request to the Yaser USMLE team.

publicTerms.title: Terms and Conditions
publicTerms.subtitle: These terms explain the responsibilities of learners and the platform when creating an account, purchasing courses or bundles, and accessing educational content.
publicTerms.helpText: If you have a question about these terms, contact our team before completing a purchase.

account.title: Personal, secure account
account.body: Protect your login details and do not share your account.

payment.title: Clear payment review
payment.body: Access activates after the payment request and transfer proof are reviewed.

access.title: Educational use only
access.body: Content is licensed personally and may not be copied or redistributed.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By using the Yaser USMLE website or application, creating an account, or purchasing a course or bundle, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these terms. If you disagree with any part, you should not use the services.

account.title: Account and eligibility
account.body: Some platform features require an account with accurate, current information. You are responsible for activity through your account and for notifying us promptly of unauthorized use.

points.1: Provide an accurate name, email address, and registration information.
points.2: Keep your password confidential and do not share your account.
points.3: Use one account per learner unless the platform agrees otherwise in writing.

content.title: Nature of educational content
content.body: The platform provides USMLE Step 1 preparation content for education and review. It is not medical advice or a replacement for official references or clinical judgment, and the platform does not guarantee a specific examination result.

payments.title: Pricing, payment, and activation
payments.body: Prices, currency, and access duration appear on the relevant course or bundle page before an order is submitted. For manual payments, the order remains pending until the team verifies the transfer and its details.

points.1: Upload clear and valid payment proof associated with your order.
points.2: Paid access begins only after payment approval and enrollment activation.
points.3: Cancellation and refund requests follow the refund policy published at purchase.

access.title: Access and permitted use
access.body: Enrollment grants a limited, personal, non-transferable license to access content for the stated duration. Access may differ across courses, bundles, and cohorts.

points.1: Do not record, download, or copy content through unauthorized methods.
points.2: Do not sell login details or share lessons and files with others.
points.3: Access may be suspended while suspected misuse is reviewed.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: All lectures, text, illustrations, questions, flashcards, marks, and designs belong to the platform or licensed rights holders. Enrollment or purchase does not grant ownership or republication rights.

conduct.title: User conduct
conduct.body: You must use the platform lawfully and respectfully without harming learners, educators, or service security. Action may be taken against accounts that violate these rules.

points.1: Do not misuse community, support, or instructor communication.
points.2: Do not bypass protection or access unauthorized data or features.
points.3: Do not upload harmful, misleading, or rights-infringing content.

changes.title: Updates and service termination
changes.body: We may update these terms, platform features, or content for operational or legal reasons. The updated version and effective date will appear here, and continued use after publication constitutes acceptance.

publicTerms.footerBody: Contact the Yaser USMLE team with questions about accounts, payment, or content access rights.

testimonials.subtitle: Hear from medical students who strengthened their foundations, improved question performance, and entered dedicated study with confidence.

item1.name: Youssef Fathy
item1.text: The cardiovascular course connected physiology, pathology, and pharmacology in a way that finally made board-style questions feel manageable.

item2.name: Amina Mansour
item2.text: The renal and acid–base lessons turned a difficult topic into a clear framework I can apply quickly to practice questions.

item3.name: Tarek Hegazi
item3.text: Weekly quizzes and detailed explanations showed me exactly where my reasoning broke down and how to fix it.

item4.name: Laila Shaheen
item4.text: The bilingual explanations helped me learn the concepts in depth while becoming comfortable with English exam terminology.

item5.name: Mahmoud Zaki
item5.text: The flexible study plan and concise high-yield reviews helped me stay consistent alongside a demanding clinical schedule.

item6.name: Sarah Al-Otaibi
item6.text: The organized system modules, flashcards, and progress tracking gave my dedicated period the structure it was missing.
